justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, exhaustive JobState enum, typed QueueError variants, and a dedicated CheckedOut handle—no stringly-typed or boolean-tagged data where a type fits.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing UnknownId/NotRunning variants and Display impl; library uses an undocumented expect in checkout and an assert! panic in new (per spec precondition) rather than returning a Result.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with doc comments on every public item, sensible derives (Copy/Clone/Eq/Hash/Debug on JobId, PartialEq/Eq/Debug/Clone/Copy on JobState), Display on the error, and std-conventional naming.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, ok_or, map, and matches! in tests, but checkout uses a manual loop instead of iterator chaining and clones the payload on every checkout rather than borrowing.
